answer: Each agent grows a crystal: a credential that only thickens through sequential, unparallelizable proofs of useful work. Verifiers send a lantern, a random probe, to wander the trust graph from every newcomer; each crystal the lantern lights within three hops that shares the newcomer's sponsor must be regrown one layer deeper. An honest agent grows one layer, but an operator with n fakes regrows every crystal for every sibling, paying about n^2 layers of serial time that money cannot speed up.
